text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a list of features described as user stories. Every day, members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to test their work often, get feedback, and improve the product step by step. As a result, Agile helps teams respond quickly to changes and deliver value to customers faster.
